title: Render the new dashboard layout at 80x24 and 120x40, with golden frames through a terminal emulator
description: Rewrite the dashboard view (internal/cli/watch_view.go and friends) to the layout in docs/design/watch-redesign-2026-10.md from the new status-model fields: header (epic title, config, where, elapsed), needs-you line/box, health line, phase track, NOW/DONE/UP NEXT/HELD groups (UP NEXT collapsed to one line beyond the screen), latest sentences, key hints. Keep enter (tick drill-down) and e (events) working. Golden frames for the five scenarios at 80x24 and 120x40 rendered through the repo's terminal-emulator test harness (see existing watch_pty tests); attach vhs/freeze screenshots of the five at 120x40 to the report.
